_comment: R4-2: block-dangerous-cmds missing destructive verbs. 'srm -rf' (secure-delete), 'chflags -R schg' (set immutable flag on whole subtree), and 'shred' are not named in DANGER_RE or any other check. All EXIT=0 (allow). srm/shred are permanent-overwrite deletions; chflags schg makes files immutable system-wide, defeating future rm attempts.
